import numpy as np


class GCNNodeClassifier:
    """Two-layer GCN for node classification."""
    
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim, num_classes):
        self.W1 = np.random.randn(input_dim, hidden_dim) * np.sqrt(2.0 / (input_dim + hidden_dim))
        self.W2 = np.random.randn(hidden_dim, num_classes) * np.sqrt(2.0 / (hidden_dim + num_classes))
    
    def forward(self, A_norm, X):
        self.H1 = np.maximum(0, A_norm @ X @ self.W1)
        self.Z = A_norm @ self.H1 @ self.W2
        return self.Z
    
    def softmax(self, logits):
        exp_logits = np.exp(logits - np.max(logits, axis=1, keepdims=True))
        return exp_logits / exp_logits.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    
    def cross_entropy_loss(self, logits, labels, mask):
        probs = self.softmax(logits)
        n_labeled = np.sum(mask)
        one_hot = np.zeros_like(probs)
        one_hot[np.arange(len(labels)), labels] = 1.0
        loss = -np.sum(mask[:, np.newaxis] * one_hot * np.log(probs + 1e-8)) / n_labeled
        return loss
    
    def train_step(self, A_norm, X, labels, mask, lr=0.01):
        logits = self.forward(A_norm, X)
        loss = self.cross_entropy_loss(logits, labels, mask)
        probs = self.softmax(logits)
        one_hot = np.zeros_like(probs)
        one_hot[np.arange(len(labels)), labels] = 1.0
        dZ = (probs - one_hot) * mask[:, np.newaxis]
        dW2 = self.H1.T @ (A_norm.T @ dZ)
        dH1 = (A_norm @ dZ) @ self.W2.T
        dH1 = dH1 * (self.H1 > 0)
        dW1 = (A_norm @ X).T @ (A_norm.T @ dH1)
        self.W1 -= lr * dW1
        self.W2 -= lr * dW2
        return loss
